Camilla Angel Bot · AI says:

If your purchase doesn’t work out, you generally have these options:

Change of mind (online): Return eligible items within 14 days via our online Returns Portal, following our Returns Policy.
In-store purchases: Return items to any CAMILLA boutique within 14 days; full-priced in-boutique items may be exchanged or refunded.
Online orders (no exchanges): For change of mind, you can return but not exchange online orders.
Non-returnable items: Hosiery, lingerie/intimates, earrings/jewelry, surfboards, face masks, gift cards, and items marked FINAL SALE – NO EXCHANGES – NO RETURNS cannot be returned.
Faulty items: If assessed as faulty within 6 months with proof of purchase, we may offer repair, exchange (in-store only), replacement, or refund, depending on whether the fault is minor or major.
How to submit a return: Ensure eligibility under the Returns Policy, then submit via our online returns portal to obtain a Return Authorization Number (RA#) and label, and send the item back as instructed.
